<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#063336" flood-opacity=".10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9FAFA"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41 AM</text>
  <g stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <line x1="325" y1="18" x2="325" y2="14"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="18" x2="330" y2="12"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="18" x2="335" y2="10"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="18" x2="340" y2="8"/>
    <path d="M348 13 Q353 8 358 13 M350 16 Q353 13 356 16"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="365" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <rect x="386" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>

  <!-- Support header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="72" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="99" x2="390" y2="99" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="30,56 22,64 30,72" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="63" r="22" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="57" r="7" fill="#4B9460"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="71" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#4B9460"/>
  <circle cx="77" cy="80" r="6" fill="#40BF76" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="94" y="57" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#0A2533">
    <tspan x="94" dy="0" font-size="18" font-weight="600">Mint Support</tspan>
    <tspan x="94" dy="20" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4B9460">Typically replies in a few minutes</tspan>
  </text>
  <circle cx="353" cy="62" r="16" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
  <circle cx="353" cy="58" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="58" x2="353" y2="61" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="61" x2="357" y2="63" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>

  <!-- Conversation date -->
  <text x="195" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#97A2B0">
    <tspan font-size="11" font-weight="500">TODAY, JUNE 14</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Agent message 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <path d="M22 145 Q22 137 30 137 H280 Q288 137 288 145 V183 Q288 191 280 191 H38 L27 198 L29 190 Q22 188 22 180 Z" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  </g>
  <text x="38" y="158" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#0A2533">
    <tspan x="38" dy="0" font-size="14" font-weight="400">Hi Maya! Thanks for reaching out.</tspan>
    <tspan x="38" dy="20" font-size="14" font-weight="400">How can I help you today?</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="296" y="190" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#97A2B0">9:32 AM</text>

  <!-- Customer message 1 -->
  <path d="M116 218 Q116 210 124 210 H357 Q365 210 365 218 V258 Q365 266 357 266 H134 L123 273 L125 265 Q116 263 116 255 Z" fill="#1DAB87"/>
  <text x="132" y="231" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="132" dy="0" font-size="14" font-weight="400">My order arrived, but one item</tspan>
    <tspan x="132" dy="20" font-size="14" font-weight="400">was missing from the bag.</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="307" y="265" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82">9:34 AM  ✓✓</text>

  <!-- Agent message 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <path d="M22 293 Q22 285 30 285 H319 Q327 285 327 293 V351 Q327 359 319 359 H38 L27 366 L29 358 Q22 356 22 348 Z" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  </g>
  <text x="38" y="307" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#0A2533">
    <tspan x="38" dy="0" font-size="14" font-weight="400">I’m sorry about that! I’ll check</tspan>
    <tspan x="38" dy="20" font-size="14" font-weight="400">with the kitchen right away.</tspan>
    <tspan x="38" dy="20" font-size="14" font-weight="400">Could you share your order number?</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="335" y="358" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#97A2B0">9:35 AM</text>

  <!-- Customer message 2 -->
  <path d="M168 389 Q168 381 176 381 H357 Q365 381 365 389 V427 Q365 435 357 435 H186 L175 442 L177 434 Q168 432 168 424 Z" fill="#1DAB87"/>
  <text x="184" y="403" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="184" dy="0" font-size="14" font-weight="400">It’s MF-28491. The missing item</tspan>
    <tspan x="184" dy="20" font-size="14" font-weight="400">was the lemon herb rice.</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="302" y="434" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82">9:36 AM  ✓✓</text>

  <!-- Agent message 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <path d="M22 464 Q22 456 30 456 H346 Q354 456 354 464 V522 Q354 530 346 530 H38 L27 537 L29 529 Q22 527 22 519 Z" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  </g>
  <text x="38" y="478" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#0A2533">
    <tspan x="38" dy="0" font-size="14" font-weight="400">Thanks, I found your order. The</tspan>
    <tspan x="38" dy="20" font-size="14" font-weight="400">kitchen confirmed the mix-up.</tspan>
    <tspan x="38" dy="20" font-size="14" font-weight="400">A $6.50 refund is on its way.</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="330" y="529" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#97A2B0">9:38 AM</text>

  <!-- Resolution card -->
  <rect x="22" y="558" width="346" height="70" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="593" r="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
  <polyline points="41,593 46,598 55,588" fill="none" stroke="#40BF76" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="74" y="584" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" fill="#0A2533">
    <tspan x="74" dy="0" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Refund requested</tspan>
    <tspan x="74" dy="19" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">$6.50 • Usually completed in 3–5 days</tspan>
  </text>
  <polyline points="343,586 349,592 343,598" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Input area -->
  <rect x="0" y="646" width="390" height="76" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="646" x2="390" y2="646" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="20" y="662" width="300" height="44" rx="22" fill="#F2F4F8"/>
  <text x="42" y="689" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#97A2B0">Write a message...</text>
  <circle cx="344" cy="684" r="22" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <polyline points="334,684 352,676 348,693 343,686 334,684" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="343" y1="686" x2="352" y2="676" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="722" width="390" height="122" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="722" x2="390" y2="722" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polygon points="38,760 50,750 62,760 62,774 54,774 54,765 46,765 46,774 38,774" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="130" cy="760" r="10"/>
    <polyline points="130,754 130,766 136,766" />
    <rect x="202" y="752" width="20" height="16" rx="3"/>
    <polygon points="207,768 207,773 213,768" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="298" cy="756" r="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="298" cy="771" rx="10" ry="6"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="212" cy="749" r="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <text x="0" y="790" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">
    <tspan x="50" font-size="10" fill="#97A2B0">Home</tspan>
    <tspan x="130" font-size="10" fill="#97A2B0">Orders</tspan>
    <tspan x="212" font-size="10" fill="#5DB329" font-weight="600">Support</tspan>
    <tspan x="298" font-size="10" fill="#97A2B0">Profile</tspan>
  </text>
  <line x1="174" y1="830" x2="216" y2="830" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
